title: Snow and Ice Days Out: Indoor Skiing and Ice Skating
description: Snow and ice days out for families: indoor real-snow slopes for ski and snowboard lessons, snow play, ice rinks, festive skating and first-timer tips.
intro: No mountains needed. Indoor real-snow centres and ice rinks bring winter fun to your doorstep all year round.

image.alt: People skating on an outdoor ice rink

blocks.title: Scout’s snowy verdict
blocks.text: Book a beginner lesson rather than just a slope pass. It’s safer, more fun and you’ll actually learn.

sections.html:
• Gloves are usually required on snow slopes and rinks.
  • Wear thick socks and layers. Helmets are often provided or recommended.
  • Skate aids help small children balance on the ice.

More in indoor snow centres and ice skating with kids.

faqs.q: Can you ski indoors in the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. Indoor real-snow centres such as the Snowdome in Tamworth and Chill Factore in Manchester offer lessons, slope time and snow play.
